repo_notes.content: VS Code extension (TypeScript) companion for three Jekyll gems — jekyll-imgflow, jekyll-documents, and jekyll-icon-flow. Registers three completion providers (image names, document references, icon names) for Liquid tags in Markdown and Liquid files. Published to Open VSX, not the VS Code Marketplace.

Build: tsc compiles src/ -> out/ (npm run compile; no bundler). js-yaml is a devDependency bundled into the VSIX via .vscodeignore exceptions (!node_modules/js-yaml/**, !node_modules/argparse/**) so config.ts can parse _config.yml at runtime.

vsce rejects SVG badge URLs in packaged READMEs — npm run package generates a sanitized README via scripts/prepare-vsix-readme.mjs (single packaging transform; never maintain a second committed README).

Key pins: @types/vscode must match engines.vscode minimum (1.91.0); mocha stays v11 (EDH harness is CJS, mocha 12 is ESM-only); typescript stays v6 (v7/tsgo needs deliberate evaluation). .npmrc min-release-age=7 avoids fresh supply-chain releases.

Release: npm version patch -> push v* tag -> publish.yml re-runs integration matrix, packages VSIX, creates GitHub release, publishes to Open VSX (needs OVSX_PAT secret). CHANGELOG entry matching the tag is a hard gate.
See AGENTS.md for build commands, test tiers (Vitest unit + @vscode/test-electron integration), and conventions.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Extension structure: extension.ts activate() builds WorkspaceIndexes, registers Imgflow/Documents/Icons completion providers for markdown and liquid languages with broad trigger characters, plus a status bar item; tsc compiles src/ to out/

page_notes.content: Include Mermaid diagram: VS Code -> extension host -> WorkspaceIndexes (images/documents/icons) -> three completion providers

pages.title: ImgFlow Image Completion
pages.purpose: completionProvider.ts: image-name suggestions from imgflow.originals and parameter completion for {% imgflow %} — sizes (width:/height:/ratio:/aspect_ratio:), formats, quality:, preset:, crop/watermark, HTML attributes, link:, modal:, and markup: output formats

pages.title: Documents Completion
pages.purpose: documentsCompletionProvider.ts: document titles in {% doc_link %}, categories in {% doc_category %}, parameter completion (text:/icon:/size:/list:/limit:/aggregate:/path:/category:), coverage of {% document_icon %} and {% latest_documents %}, and exact path: insertion to disambiguate duplicate titles

pages.title: Icons Completion
pages.purpose: iconsCompletionProvider.ts + iconPackNames.ts: icon names for {% icon %}, {% icon_<pack> %}, {% <pack>_icon %}, {% icon_ref %}; icon_flow.pack/registry/search resolution, custom_dir live indexing, named sizes xxs..xxl, and class:/title:/pack: parameters

pages.title: Indexes and Config Discovery
pages.purpose: workspaceIndexes.ts orchestrates imageIndex/documentIndex/iconIndex built from imageFiles/documentFiles/iconFiles collectors via fileCollector.ts; config.ts parses _config.yml with js-yaml (imgflow.originals, documents.root/include_extensions/strict_filename/categories_from_path/category_map, icon_flow.*) and watchers refresh indexes on file/config change; jekyllImgFlow.originals/.formats settings override

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: Two-tier tests: Vitest unit tests (test/*.test.ts with a Jekyll fixture site) vs @vscode/test-electron Extension Development Host integration tests (test/run-integration.ts), V8 coverage capture/remap for both (c8), CI matrix against minimum and stable VS Code

pages.title: Packaging, Release, and CI
pages.purpose: vsce packaging with .vscodeignore (bundled js-yaml/argparse exceptions), prepare-vsix-readme.mjs sanitized-README transform, npm version -> v* tag -> publish.yml (integration matrix + VSIX + GitHub release + Open VSX publish), CHANGELOG gate, OVSX_PAT secret, Dependabot cooldown
